Whats the purpose of this ? Is this the format of a standard TPS image
This check is needed because the TPS image begins with a comment block (/** WARNING:). Without skipping lines containing /*, the parser would try to process the comment as data.

This bit in regStatusMfrSpecific2 indicates whether the NVM is writable. Since the comment describes the implementation details, I moved it to where the bit is actually used.
